thread:
incident-bot: PAGER P1 — cross-region health oscillation detected

incident-bot: Alerts: health_check_fail_rate spike > 12% in us-east for 120s, automatic fallback engaged to us-west then eu, detected cyclical failover pattern (us-east -> us-west -> eu -> us-east). Autobalance policy: smart-fallback-v2. Impact: a subset of routed requests experienced elevated latency and 502s.

maya (on-call): I'm on it — paging eng-sre and runtime. Paging sam and li.

sam (eng-sre): I see the alert. Can someone post the last config deploy diff for us-east?

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T09:20Z by aj — changed probe timeout from 250ms -> 120ms for runtime readiness in us-east-only.

li (runtime): whoops. That was the small perf tweak for faster failover on degraded nodes. Looks like it reduced grace window too far.

maya (on-call): Traffic graph: 95th latency jumped ~220ms for endpoints that hit fallbacks, error rate up 0.9% overall but concentrated on three customer routes. Customer-impact note: Ryan, can you confirm which customers we should notify?

ryan (cust-succ): Quick check — two Enterprise customers (acme-corp, bluebox) reported increased 502s. Escalating from support. Bluebox sees timeouts for 2-3% of requests.

sam (eng-sre): Hypothesis: tightened readiness probe caused transient node churn in us-east, smart-fallback policy interpreted the short window as sustained failure and rerouted to the next preferred region. Because eu's health-checks briefly edged out and then recovered, policy kept rotating. Essentially a feedback loop between rapid probe failures and fallback policy cooldowns.

li (runtime): Confirmed in logs:
```
[2026-03-15T09:21:12Z] node/instance-122 readiness=false (probe latency 138ms > 120ms)
[2026-03-15T09:21:14Z] smart-router: route-change us-east -> us-west (policy smart-fallback-v2)
[2026-03-15T09:21:18Z] node/instance-122 readiness=true
[2026-03-15T09:21:23Z] smart-router: route-change us-west -> eu
[2026-03-15T09:21:26Z] node/instance-130 readiness=false (probe latency 140ms)
[2026-03-15T09:21:30Z] smart-router: route-change eu -> us-east
```
This pattern repeats.

aj (eng-infra): The change was pushed only to us-east a few minutes ago (canary). Canary policy should have isolated it, but smart-fallback's global aggregation window is 60s so it saw the transient spike across overall metrics due to sampling.

maya (on-call): Immediate mitigation proposals — pick one and execute:
1) Temporarily disable cross-region automatic fallback (flip to local-preference)
2) Increase readiness probe timeout in us-east back to 250ms
3) Pin critical customers to specific region variants until stable
4) Increase smart-fallback cooldown/hold window to avoid fast oscillation

sam (eng-sre): I'm going to flip #1 now (disable cross-region auto fallback) to stop immediate cycling, then apply #2 in parallel for us-east, then revert fallback after stabilization.

sam (eng-sre): /run playbook disable-cross-region-fallback smart-fallback-v2 -> OK

incident-bot: Action logged: user sam executed disable-cross-region-fallback at 2026-03-15T09:22:05Z

maya (on-call): sam — after you flip fallback, please monitor error rates and latency for 5 minutes. If stable, we can roll ##2.

sam (eng-sre): Observing now — error rate dropping for routes that formerly bounced. Latency heading back down.

li (runtime): I'm applying probe timeout rollback for us-east canary now:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/runtime-proxy READINESS_TIMEOUT=250 --context=us-east
```

deploy-bot: rollout started runtime-proxy/us-east canary -> 3 pods updated

li (runtime): Rollout 1/3 healthy. 2/3 healthy. 3/3 healthy.

sam (eng-sre): Good. Now increase smart-fallback hold window to 180s as precaution (temp)

maya (on-call): Can we also pin acme-corp and bluebox to us-east to avoid customer impact while we stabilize?

li (runtime): Added temporary route pins for acme-corp and bluebox -> us-east: route-manager: pin=true ttl=30m

ryan (cust-succ): Notifying customers: "We detected routing instability affecting a small percentage of requests; we've applied mitigations and pinned traffic to stable regions. We're monitoring and will follow up with RCA."

aj (eng-infra): Monitoring dashboards show oscillation stopped at 09:24Z. Error rate back to baseline 0.05% for most routes.

maya (on-call): Status: mitigation in place, cross-region auto fallback disabled, readiness timeout restored, pinned critical customers, extended hold window. Remaining tasks: full RCA, revert temp pins, add guardrails to prevent single-region probe change from triggering global fallback. Assigning owners:
- RCA writeup: sam (eng-sre)
- Postmortem draft: maya (on-call) + li (runtime)
- Customer follow-up: ryan (cust-succ)
- Policy change (smart-fallback): aj (eng-infra)

sam (eng-sre): Initial RCA notes: root cause = aggressive readiness timeout change in us-east canary + smart-fallback's global aggregation and low hold window. Contributing: canary isolation not strict enough for health-metric sampling; automation lacked a per-region decay factor.

li (runtime): Action items for safety:
- Add per-region probe thresholds and per-region evaluation windows
- Make canary readiness changes default to a longer grace period when toggling timeouts
- Add explicit guard: do not trigger region-level fallback unless > 3 nodes or > 30s of sustained failures

maya (on-call): Escalation update: severity lowered to P2 at 09:30Z. No major revenue-impacting outages. Customers notified.

emma (pager): Handoff — I'll take watch for next 2 hours while sam continues RCA.

sam (eng-sre): Will post full postmortem by EOD. Quick note — let's include a new test in canary pipeline that simulates transient probe flapping to exercise smart-fallback.

ana (product): (ana) — please add to postmortem: business impact estimate and whether sales org needs extra outreach.

maya (on-call): Closing timeline: incident opened 09:20Z, mitigations applied by 09:24Z, degraded customer experience limited and pinned. Moving to incident review.

incident-bot: Incident closed to active pager at 09:32Z — follow-up tasks created: #INC-2026-2334 (RCA), #TICKET-4556 (policy change).
__notes_for_dataset_team: generated Slack thread for region fallback loop due to probe config change; includes on-call coordination, bot messages, logs, mitigation steps, and handoff.
